results.name: actor_look_pick_random_direction
results.evidence: Uses unit pitch/yaw limit pair (via 004150f0) and calls actor_look_pick_random_point_in_cone (00415260, hint vector3d) then actor_look_get_wait_ticks (00415150) storing result at actor+0x580/0x568
results.summary: Picks a new random gaze/look direction constrained to the unit's aim cone and arms the look timer for the actor.

results.name: actor_get_unit_aim_pitch_limits
results.evidence: Selects one of three offsets (unit+0xf4/0x10c/0xdc) into the unit struct based on an actor posture/state field at actor+0x3fc; register-only (in_EAX) argument
results.summary: Returns a pointer into the actor's unit structure holding the aim-pitch limit pair appropriate for the actor's current posture.

results.name: actor_look_get_wait_ticks
results.evidence: Picks one of three unaff_EDI vector pairs by param_1, mixes in a PRNG (DAT_00719cd0 LCG) fraction, scales by unit field +0x410 and an urgency multiplier of 1.5, then multiplies by 30.0 (fps) rounding to a frame count clamped >=1
results.summary: Computes a randomized delay in ticks (at 30 fps) before the actor's next look-direction update, optionally scaled by an urgency flag.

results.name: actor_look_pick_random_point_in_cone
results.evidence: Randomly rotates a base vector by yaw/pitch drawn uniformly from [param_2,param_3]x[param_4,param_5] using vector3d_rotate_about_axis and fsin/fcos, optionally validating the resulting look point via FUN_00505880 up to 10 tries, then renormalizes into *param_6
results.summary: Generates a normalized random direction vector within a given yaw/pitch cone, retrying against a validity test when requested.

results.name: actor_update_look_target
results.evidence: Reads actor look-mode field at +0x6dc, branches on unit posture/vehicle seat (+0x6a==3) selecting different unit orientation fields (0xbc/0xb4 etc.), and calls the look-direction helpers 00414910/00414990/00414d00/00414f50/004150f0/00415150 plus obstacle/vector helpers
results.summary: Large per-tick routine that decides where the actor should be looking (aim target, idle scan, vehicle-relative) and updates its stored look vector and timers.

results.name: actor_update_melee_dodge_waypoints
results.evidence: Walks an array of dodge waypoints at actor+0x4a8 (stride 0x10) using offsets +0x4c1/+0x4c2 as index bounds, testing proximity/line-segment distance (0.0225/0.0625 thresholds) to advance the index, and falls back to picking a lateral dodge offset when action state (+0x15e)==4
results.summary: Advances the actor along a queued dodge waypoint path, or computes a fresh lateral dodge destination when no path is queued.

results.name: actor_check_grenade_throw_reached
results.evidence: Compares squared distance from actor position (+300/+0x130/+0x134) to a stored throw target (+0x488..0x490) against a max-throw-distance from FUN_00429620, setting completion flag at +0x484 when the throw mode (+0x46c) isn't 0/1 and target is out of range
results.summary: Checks whether the actor has moved close enough to its planned grenade-throw position and marks the action complete if so.

results.name: actor_movement_update
results.evidence: Reads/derives movement mode at actor+0x6dc from posture (+0x6a), computes a desired velocity vector into +0x5a4/+0x5a8/+0x5ac from several sub-cases (dodge, dive, dodge-to-explicit-point), and feeds it to actor_movement_apply_direction (004180c0)
results.summary: Per-tick actor movement decision routine that selects a movement mode and desired direction, then applies obstacle-aware steering to it.

results.name: actor_get_movement_turn_radii
results.evidence: Reads vehicle physics fields (object flags bit 4 at +0x2f4, turning-radius floats at +0x334/0x33c/0x340) when the actor is attached to a vehicle-like object (obj+0x158==-1 path), else falls back to fixed constants (0.0833/0.0167/0.0267), outputting via unaff_EBX/EDI pointers
results.summary: Computes linear/angular turning-radius bounds (from vehicle physics or defaults) used elsewhere for movement path cost estimation.

results.name: actor_movement_action_stop
results.evidence: Sets the pending movement-action type field (actor+0x400) to 1 and copies it into the active slot (+0x46c) unless already 1, then calls the action dispatcher 0041a460 which treats type 0/1 as an immediately-complete no-op action; redirects to actor_movement_set_destination_point when a dodge is active (+0x15e==4 && +0x504)
results.summary: Cancels the actor's current movement goal by queuing a trivial 'stop/hold position' action (or redirecting into a dodge return point).

results.name: actor_movement_set_destination_point
results.evidence: Queues movement-action type 2 with a literal position from in_EAX vector plus param_2/param_3; the dispatcher (0041a460) case 2 copies this position directly into the active destination fields (+0x488..0x494)
results.summary: Queues a movement action that sends the actor directly to an explicit world-space point.

results.name: actor_movement_set_destination_firing_point
results.evidence: Queues movement-action type 4 with a short index (param_1); dispatcher case 4 looks the index up in an encounter firing-position table (DAT_00746f8c chunk, entry stride 0x50) to build the destination
results.summary: Queues a movement action that sends the actor to a specific encounter firing/anchor position by index.

results.name: actor_movement_set_destination_formation_point
results.evidence: Queues movement-action type 3 with a short index (param_1); dispatcher case 3 looks the index up in a squad formation-position table (DAT_00746f8c chunk, entry stride 0x18) to build the destination
results.summary: Queues a movement action that sends the actor to a specific squad formation slot by index.

results.name: actor_movement_set_destination_near_target
results.evidence: Queues movement-action type 5 with an object index (in_EAX) and a float radius (param_2); dispatcher case 5 reads the target's stored position from the actor-target-data record (offsets 0xf0/200) to build the destination
results.summary: Queues a movement action that sends the actor toward (within a given radius of) a tracked target object.

results.name: actor_movement_action_cancel
results.evidence: Sets both the pending-action cancel flag (actor+0x402) and the active-action mirror flag (+0x46e) to 1, matching the cancellation flags cleared to 0 whenever a new movement action is queued elsewhere
results.summary: Marks the actor's currently queued/active movement action as cancelled.

results.name: actor_action_try_queue_secondary
results.evidence: Checks a secondary action slot (actor+0x418 == -1, or clears via FUN_00569c90 when the actor has a target), then stores param_1/param_2 into +0x418/0x41c/0x420 and returns success
results.summary: Attempts to queue a secondary actor action into an available slot, failing if one is already pending.

results.name: actor_action_try_start_default_look
results.evidence: Similar slot-availability check on actor+0x418 as 00417a60, but on success resets the dodge flag (+0x504) and copies a default direction constant (PTR_DAT_00696714) into +0x6e0..0x6e8, clearing +0x6ec
results.summary: If no secondary action is pending, resets the actor's look/movement bias to a default direction.

results.name: actor_action_has_queued_secondary
results.evidence: Returns true if actor+0x418 != -1, or if the actor has a target object and FUN_00569c90 (a target-related check) returns true; mirrors the gating logic in 00417a60/0417ae0
results.summary: Reports whether the actor currently has a secondary action pending (or an equivalent target-driven condition).

results.name: actor_movement_try_step
results.evidence: Builds a candidate step position (param_1 * direction + actor position) and validates it via FUN_0043de90 (path/surface trace) and FUN_00502060 (a sphere/shape sweep against DAT_00746f98), writing an 'adjusted' flag through param_3
results.summary: Tests whether the actor can move a given distance forward along a direction without hitting an obstacle, adjusting height/side as needed.

results.name: actor_movement_try_side_step
results.evidence: Wraps actor_movement_try_step (00417bb0) in a small retry loop over one or two side choices (*param_3 selects/records which side), randomizing the initial side via the DAT_00719cd0 PRNG when the caller passes side value 4
results.summary: Tries stepping to one side (or both, picking randomly first) and reports which side succeeded via *param_3.

results.name: actor_get_jump_velocity
results.evidence: When the actor is not attached to an object (obj index == -1) and a stored jump-velocity flag (+0x530) is set, computes a velocity vector from stored jump physics fields (+0x534..0x540) and clamps its magnitude to param_2
results.summary: Computes (and clamps) the actor's stored jump/leap launch velocity vector for use by movement code.

results.name: actor_movement_apply_direction
results.evidence: Normalizes an input direction, dispatches through a movement-submode jump table (PTR_LAB_00418a04) for special modes (in_AX 0..3), otherwise blends the new direction against the actor's previous heading using a max-turn-angle threshold (cos(30deg)=0.866) before writing the smoothed result
results.summary: Core steering/turn-smoothing routine that converts a desired movement direction into the actor's applied heading, honoring per-mode special handling and a maximum turn rate.

results.name: vector3d_pick_closest_axis_direction
results.evidence: Iterates 4 candidate direction vectors (a vector and its negations/permutations) scoring each by two dot products against unaff_EDI/unaff_ESI reference vectors and returns the best-scoring index and vector via param_2/param_1
results.summary: Chooses whichever of four candidate axis-aligned directions best matches two reference vectors, for use in movement/orientation snapping.

results.name: vector_transform_by_actor_orientation
results.evidence: Transforms param_1 by a 2x2 (in_AL==0) or 3x3 (in_AL!=0) basis pulled from in_ECX / FUN_0055eed0, then renormalizes via vector3d_normalize_with_length
results.summary: Rotates a direction vector into (or out of) the actor's local orientation frame, in either a 2D or full 3D variant.

results.name: actor_movement_collect_obstacle_candidates
results.evidence: Calls object_find_in_sphere around the actor's object position, filters hits with a positive marker-list count (obj+0x280), transforms each marker with matrix4x3_transform_point, and fills an obstacle array (param_1+0x40+i*0x18) with position/radius data
results.summary: Builds the actor's list of nearby dynamic obstacles (with effective radii) used by the movement obstacle-avoidance system.

results.name: actor_movement_test_obstacle_ray
results.evidence: Computes a probe ray from actor state (unaff_EDI struct) and tests it against a self-collision cylinder via FUN_00502060 and against each obstacle in the list built by actor_movement_collect_obstacle_candidates via ray_intersects_cylinder, returning the nearest clearance distance and a touch counter
results.summary: Casts a probe ray along a candidate movement direction and reports the nearest obstacle clearance distance.

results.name: geometry_ray_polygon_edge_intersect
results.evidence: Iterates a small polygon's edges computing cross products against in_ECX to find the edge the ray direction crosses, then interpolates a parametric value into *param_3/*param_4
results.summary: Generic helper that finds where a direction vector crosses the boundary of a small convex polygon, used by the obstacle-avoidance sampler.

results.name: actor_movement_choose_avoidance_direction
results.evidence: Builds an 8-direction weight table (local_6090), calls actor_movement_collect_obstacle_candidates (0418ce0) and actor_movement_test_obstacle_ray (0418f70) per sample direction, blends in target-direction bias via geometry_ray_polygon_edge_intersect (0419240), and outputs a turn value/speed scale used by actor_movement_update
results.summary: Core obstacle-avoidance steering computation: samples several candidate directions around the desired heading and picks the best compromise between goal direction and obstacle clearance.

results.name: actor_movement_precompute_direction_tables
results.evidence: Fills fixed global arrays (DAT_008805a4.., DAT_0088038c..) with sin/cos-derived unit vectors at regular angular increments using constant tables (DAT_006556ec etc.), consistent with a one-time lookup-table initializer for the 8-direction avoidance sampler used in 004193d0
results.summary: One-time initialization routine that precomputes direction-sample vector tables used by the movement obstacle-avoidance system.

results.name: actor_movement_action_complete
results.evidence: Sets actor+0x4a8=0 (not-cancelled), +0x484=1 (done), +0x4a0=0 (elapsed timer), the same trio of writes performed at the tail of the movement-action dispatcher (0041a460) and by actor_update_melee_dodge_waypoints on early-out
results.summary: Marks the actor's current movement action as finished (clears cancel flag, sets completion flag, resets timer).

results.name: actor_movement_action_resolve
results.evidence: Switches on the active movement-action type (actor+0x46c: 2=explicit point, 3=squad formation index, 4=encounter firing index, 5=tracked-target object) to build a destination, then invokes pathfinding helpers (FUN_0043a070/0043a190/0043a4d0/0043a700/0043a730/0043a8b0) and reports success/failure
results.summary: Resolves the actor's currently queued movement action into a concrete destination and drives the pathfinder toward it, called once per tick.

results.name: actor_movement_action_is_complete
results.evidence: Returns the raw byte at actor+0x4a8, the same flag set to 1 by actor_movement_action_complete (0041a430) and cleared to 0 whenever a new action is queued
results.summary: Returns whether the actor's current movement action has finished.

results.name: actor_movement_action_in_progress
results.evidence: Returns false only when actor+0x4a8 (complete) is set and actor+0x484 (cancelled/done) is clear, i.e. the inverse combination used elsewhere to detect a still-running action
results.summary: Reports whether the actor still has an active (not yet completed) movement action.

results.name: actor_movement_build_path_request
results.evidence: Zeroes an 18-dword request block (unaff_EBX) and fills it with the actor's squad/target index, per-target max-speed override (obj+0x38c), and unit orientation vectors (actor+0x164..0x170), then calls FUN_00429570 (a pathfinding entry point elsewhere in this module)
results.summary: Assembles a pathfinding request block describing the actor's current position, orientation, and speed limits.

results.name: actor_movement_should_settle_orientation
results.evidence: Only applies when action state (+0x15e)==4, requiring a non-negative danger-relevance value (obj+0x388), a near-idle speed threshold (+0x5ec<0.9), and a facing dot-product test (>=0.984, i.e. within ~10 degrees) before returning false ('stop turning')
results.summary: Checks whether the actor is close enough to its destination and well enough aligned that it can stop actively turning toward it.

results.name: actor_target_relationship_think
results.evidence: Large per-target-data state machine (actor+targetdata offset 0x24 states 0-5) that calls dodge/aim updates (0041c4b0/0041c8f0), target-data release (0041b980), squad communication events (FUN_0042d340 with ids 8/0xf/0x19), and posture escalation (FUN_00422130/004221b0)
results.summary: Per-tick think routine for one actor/target relationship record: advances its engagement state machine and drives related combat behaviors and dialogue.

results.name: actor_target_data_release
results.evidence: For target-data states outside 2..3, copies summary fields (0x50-0x5c, 0x9c-0xa8) from a linked entry, calls FUN_00428470/FUN_0043ea20/datum_delete, clears the link field, sets state=3 and cleared combat flags (0xb9/0xba/0xbb), matching actor_target_reset_combat_flags's tail
results.summary: Releases a linked target-data record (deleting its datum and clearing the link) once the actor is done actively engaging it.

results.name: actor_target_reset_combat_flags
results.evidence: Clears target-data flags at +0xb9/+0xba/+0xbb and sets +0x64=1, then calls FUN_00421c20; identical tail sequence appears inside actor_target_data_release (0041b980)
results.summary: Resets a target-data record's combat status flags, e.g. after losing track of or re-acquiring a target.

results.name: actor_dispatch_look_handler_by_posture
results.evidence: Early-outs unless unaff_BX is 0 or 1, calls actor_get_actor_definition, then jumps through a function-pointer table (PTR_LAB_0041be00) indexed by in_stack_00000018
results.summary: Dispatches to one of several per-posture handler functions via a jump table, gated on the actor's current stance.

results.name: actor_target_get_priority_class
results.evidence: Classifies a target-data record into a small integer (0-3) based on its combat state (2..3 or seat state 1/2 forces 3) and awareness flags at target-data+0x60/+0x127, falling back to actor posture (+0x6a/+0x6e) when in_ECX is -1
results.summary: Computes a priority/urgency class (0-3) for a given target relative to the actor, used to rank target handling.

results.name: unit_get_move_speed_for_range
results.evidence: Pure math helper interpolating forward/turn speed outputs (*param_4/*param_5) from unit speed-profile thresholds at unit+0x1c/0x20/0x28/0x2c based on a distance param_3, with no actor-array access besides the implicit unit lookup via in_EAX
results.summary: Blends the unit's near/far movement speed settings based on distance-to-target, producing forward and turn speed scalars.

results.name: actor_target_hearing_check
results.evidence: Computes squared planar distance to a target and compares it against a stealth/crouch-scaled hearing radius, then calls chimera__cluster_sound_distance_func to test an actual acoustic path, returning a 0-3 detection level
results.summary: Determines whether the actor can hear a nearby target based on distance and acoustic cluster propagation, returning a graded detection level.

results.name: actor_get_firing_positions
results.evidence: When actor flag +6 is clear, bulk-copies the actor's local 14-vec4 firing-position block from +0x120; otherwise scans an encounter firing-point cluster table (DAT_0088035c chunk, stride 0x40) for the nearest entry to *in_EDX, returning the minimum squared distance
results.summary: Fetches the actor's set of candidate firing positions, either its cached local list or the nearest cluster of encounter firing points.

results.name: object_find_nearest_squad_member
results.evidence: Searches either a linked-object list (object+0x1fc chain) or an encounter squad member array (DAT_0088035c chunk) for the object nearest param_1's position, applying a same-object distance penalty (0.36) and optionally stamping a shared group id (param_3)
results.summary: Finds the nearest object to a given point among either a raw object linked list or a squad's member list, optionally marking group ownership.

results.name: actor_target_data_refresh
results.evidence: Revalidates a target-data record's tracked object (possibly reassigning via object_find_nearest_squad_member/0041c2c0 for squad-shared targets), then fetches marker-based aim/firing offsets (FUN_004f6080 with marker names DAT_0066bfa0/DAT_00672034) and root-object shield state via object_get_root_object_index/FUN_0053ed60
results.summary: Refreshes a target-data record's cached object reference, aim marker offsets, and root-object status for combat targeting.

results.name: actor_target_update_tracking_speed
results.evidence: Computes the target's velocity magnitude via FUN_004f6aa0 and buckets it into 0-3 (thresholds 0.00333/0.0167/0.0333) at target-data+0x123, and buckets a closing-speed dot product into 0-6 at +0x124, storing both for use in aim prediction
results.summary: Classifies a target's current speed and closing rate relative to the actor's aim into discrete buckets used for lead/prediction logic.

results.name: ai_target_distance_qsort_compare
results.evidence: Pure two-pointer function comparing *(float*)(param+8) between the two records, returning -1/0/1; passed as the comparator to _qsort inside actor_target_scan_potential_targets (0041d7e0)
results.summary: qsort comparator that orders candidate-target records by an ascending float distance field.

results.name: actor_target_scan_potential_targets
results.evidence: Builds a PVS/visibility bitmask for the actor's cluster (or encounter squad list), iterates the actor's linked target-data list checking distance/visibility gates, sorts candidates with _qsort using ai_target_distance_qsort_compare, and creates/discards target-data datums (FUN_0041c4b0, datum_delete) accordingly
results.summary: Per-tick perception scan that rebuilds the actor's list of currently-relevant potential targets from its squad/encounter and BSP visibility data.

results.name: actor_target_evaluate_squad_link
results.evidence: Walks a squad's target linked list (object+0x1fc-style chain via param_2), for each entry checking a danger-radius overlap (obj+0x284) and calling actor_get_firing_positions/object_find_nearest_squad_member/actor_danger_register_point (0041c1e0/0041c2c0/0041ec90) to pick the most relevant assist target
results.summary: Iterates a squad's list of known targets evaluating danger radius and distance to select the most relevant one for the actor to assist against.

results.name: actor_danger_register_stationary_object
results.evidence: Checks an object's flag byte at +0x2f0 (sign bit) and near-zero velocity (obj[0x1a..0x1c]^2 < 0.0011) to detect a landed hazardous object (e.g. a grenade), then registers it into the actor's danger record at +0x280 (state=3) if closer/newer than the current one
results.summary: Detects a nearby stationary hazardous object (such as a landed grenade) and records it as the actor's current danger if more urgent than what's already tracked.

results.name: actor_danger_register_point
results.evidence: Compares an incoming danger radius (param_1) and distance (param_2) against the actor's existing danger record priority (+0x2d4), and if it wins, zeroes and refills the +0x280 danger block (state=1) with the source object's position/velocity
results.summary: Registers a point-based threat (e.g. an explosion or projectile) as the actor's current danger if it outranks the one already tracked.

results.name: actor_danger_update
results.evidence: Requires an active danger record (+0x280>0), refetches the tracked object via object_try_and_get, recomputes distance/relative bearing, then branches on danger type (1: object/grenade, 2: other threat) to decide whether to trigger a dodge via actor_dispatch_look_handler_by_posture (0041bb30) and communication event FUN_0042b270
results.summary: Per-tick update of the actor's active danger record: refreshes its position/distance and decides whether the actor should react (dodge, call out) to it.

results.name: actor_target_get_relationship_object
results.evidence: Lazily resolves target-data field +0xec: if a linked relationship (+0x110) exists uses FUN_00571de0, otherwise looks up the object via object_try_and_get and FUN_0055ab30, caching the result
results.summary: Lazily resolves and caches a target-data record's associated relationship/obstruction object handle.

results.name: actor_target_has_conflicting_neighbor
results.evidence: Walks the actor's own target-data linked list (via actor+0x50 chain, entry size 0x138) looking for another entry that shares the same tracked object/group or whose firing position is within 2.5 units and facing similarly (dot product > 0.5)
results.summary: Checks whether another of the actor's tracked targets occupies a conflicting firing position or object, to avoid duplicate assignment.

results.name: actor_get_relevant_squad_member_target
results.evidence: Iterates a squad member's fixed 4-entry recent-attacker table (object+0x438), resolving each via actor_target_data_acquire-family lookups (FUN_0043ea80) and picking the highest-priority entry whose target-data state is 2/3 and (optionally) visible
results.summary: Selects the most relevant recent-attacker target from a specific squad member's short-term memory table.

results.name: actor_get_squad_recent_attacker_target
results.evidence: Nearly identical structure to actor_get_relevant_squad_member_target (0041f550) but iterates the actor's own object's recent-attacker table (object+0x430) instead of a specific squad member's
results.summary: Selects the most relevant recent-attacker target from the actor's own object's short-term attacker memory.

results.name: actor_target_data_acquire
results.evidence: Resolves or creates a target-data record for an object via FUN_0043eb30/FUN_0043e910/FUN_0043e980, merging fields when the target moves between squad-member owners, then refreshes it via actor_target_data_refresh (0041c4b0) and actor_target_update_tracking_speed (0041c8f0)
results.summary: Finds (creating if necessary) the target-data record for a given object and refreshes its tracking information, transferring ownership between squad members as needed.

results.name: actor_target_reset_seen_flags
results.evidence: Walks the actor's linked target-data list (actor+0x50 chain, stride 0x138) clearing the 'seen' byte at +0x74 and resetting the last-seen-node id at +0x6c to -1 for every entry
results.summary: Clears the visibility/'seen' state of every target-data record the actor is currently tracking.

results.name: actor_target_reset_shot_counters
results.evidence: Walks the same actor+0x50 target-data linked list as actor_target_reset_seen_flags, zeroing three adjacent short counters at +0xaa/+0xac/+0xae per entry
results.summary: Resets per-target shot/hit statistics counters for every target-data record the actor is tracking.

results.name: actor_target_mark_engaged
results.evidence: Sets or clears the engagement timestamp fields at target-data+0x9c/+0xa0 (using DAT_006f1d6c global tick counter) based on param_1, then refreshes derived fields via FUN_0041fc60/FUN_0041fd50, storing the latter into +0x50
results.summary: Marks (or clears) the current target as actively engaged and refreshes its derived combat timing fields.
